proposals.evidence: DEDR2883 gives Tamil cōri/tōrai blood, Malayalam cōri/cōra and Kodagu cōre, within the pour/trickle family. Selected southern survey corā/cora/core/śorɛ/sɔ̄rē match that blood noun, preserving source sibilants and vowels. The more divergent śuvre response remains unassigned. This is a comparative family proposal; inheritance versus local transmission in this survey lect remains subject to review.
